Local dependencies for cart PDF export; loaded only when the customer downloads a quotation.

- pdf-lib 1.17.1, https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib — MIT, `pdf-lib-LICENSE.md`.
- @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1, https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit — MIT, `fontkit-LICENSE.txt`.
  npm tarball SHA-1: f18473892b65e3253eb73f4569785abd2c03b1e0.
- DejaVu Sans 2.37 (regular and bold), https://github.com/dejavu-fonts/dejavu-fonts/releases/tag/version_2_37.
  Fonts and their license are in `../../assets/fonts/`.

No third-party requests or customer-data transmission occur during PDF generation.
